##### Project general facts

Rivage is a luxury residential development offering a diverse collection of residences, including one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, duplexes, sky villas, and ultra-exclusive sky palaces. The project is defined by its contemporary architecture, characterized by sculptural forms and elegant lines inspired by natural elements. Residences are designed with spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and an emphasis on natural light, creating sophisticated living environments that combine modern design with a strong sense of openness. The development incorporates advanced sustainable technologies and smart-home features, reinforcing its focus on contemporary, future-oriented living.

Residents have access to an extensive selection of resort-style amenities. These include a family swimming pool, children's pool, adults-only horizon pool with sunken seating, a wellness club, spinning studio, yoga area, treatment rooms, salt room, red light therapy facilities, resident lounges, a cigar lounge, an event lawn, outdoor cinema, and BBQ areas. The amenity offering is designed to support wellness, recreation, entertainment, and social interaction, providing a comprehensive lifestyle experience within the development.

The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout. Specifications include high-efficiency air-conditioning systems, façade insulation, LED lighting, ventilation systems with air filtration, smart locks, and integrated controls for lighting and air conditioning. Floor-to-ceiling windows and private balconies maximize natural light and enhance the interior environment. Kitchens are fully equipped with appliances. Residences are delivered without furniture. The overall specification combines premium materials, smart-home technology, and energy-efficient systems to create a refined and sustainable living experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Reem Island is a vibrant and rapidly developing residential and commercial district located just off the northeastern coast of Abu Dhabi. Known for its modern skyline and luxury developments, the island offers a blend of urban sophistication and serene waterfront living. It is home to a range of residential towers, many with stunning sea views and lush green parks, creating a peaceful yet connected environment. The island is designed to accommodate both high-rise living and community-focused amenities, making it a highly sought-after destination for families and professionals alike.

The island boasts a wealth of lifestyle amenities that enhance the daily experience of its residents. From world-class fitness centers and swimming pools to retail outlets and fine dining options, Al Reem Island offers a comprehensive urban lifestyle. Educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and ample recreational spaces also make it a family-friendly locale. The island’s close proximity to downtown Abu Dhabi ensures easy access to the city’s business districts, while its waterfront promenades provide a relaxed atmosphere for leisure and outdoor activities.

As part of Abu Dhabi's vision for sustainable urban development, Al Reem Island continues to evolve as a dynamic hub of residential, commercial, and leisure activities. Future projects include additional parks, retail centers, and transport infrastructure, further enhancing the island's appeal. Whether for investment or long-term living, Al Reem Island represents a balanced fusion of luxury, convenience, and community, positioning it as a key location in Abu Dhabi’s real estate landscape.
